slices.focus: Caleb rediscovers his enjoyment of older legal and civic procedural movies after a neighbor's backyard movie night, reclaiming a dormant leisure preference
slices.summary: Lena takes Caleb to a neighbor's backyard movie night featuring an older legal thriller. Caleb is surprised by how locked-in he gets, realizing he drifted away from procedural dramas without noticing. He now plans to keep a short list of older legal and civic procedurals sorted by mood, marking a recovery of active engagement over passive numbing.
